hook_vo: Jan Dhan accounts hold three point two one lakh crore rupees. Per account?

items.name: Accounts
items.sub: Portal term: beneficiaries. Money in them: ₹3.21 lakh crore.
items.vo: Fifty-nine point five four crore accounts. Thirty-three point two crore held by women.

items.name: Average
items.sub: Our calculation: balance divided by accounts, zero balances included.
items.vo: That is about five thousand three hundred and ninety rupees per account.

items.name: Lakshadweep
items.text: Lakshadweep, the highest. Manipur, the lowest.
items.vo: Lakshadweep's average is highest, about six and a half times Manipur's, the lowest.

so.vo: An average includes accounts with little or no money in them.
so.note: Lakshadweep's average is about 6.5 times Manipur's, on a small number of accounts.
